findings.title: Optimized audit-log pagination fails when building a cursor
findings.body: Audit-log rows have a `datetime` sort key, but this implementation passes that value directly to `math.floor`/`math.ceil`, which do not accept `datetime` objects. When an authorized administrator requests `optimized_pagination=true` and the result page is non-empty, cursor construction raises `TypeError` and the endpoint returns a 500. Convert the datetime to the same numeric timestamp representation used by `DateTimePaginator`.

findings.title: Negative offsets are passed to unsupported Django queryset slicing
findings.body: When advanced pagination is enabled and a cursor has a negative offset, this code evaluates a queryset slice with a negative start. Django does not support negative queryset indexing or slicing and raises `ValueError`, so such a cursor produces a server error rather than a page. Clamp or reject negative offsets before slicing; Django does not provide the claimed automatic boundary handling.
